newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius share index down in higher volume.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius share index down in higher volume.

text.p: The market index at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius fell by 1.33 points to 318.68 in higher transaction volume that was seen boosted by foreign investor trading, brokers said.
Turnover was posted at 11.70 million rupees on 335,766 shares from 2.62 million rupees on 133,034 shares on Monday.
The market trades on Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

Brokers said the index lost ground mainly due to falling stocks of several smaller companies on the official list. They added big transactions in stocks of the banking and hotel sectors saved the day.
"It appears foreign investors are again behind the big transactions on Mauritius Commercial Bank, State Bank of Mauritius, New Mauritius Hotels and Sun Resorts," one broker said.

Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 72 rupees on 98,648 shares while State Bank of Mauritius remained at 8.50 rupees on 100,980 shares despite reporting a 19 percent profit rise last Monday. New Mauritius Hotels was stable at 28 rupees on 20,700 shares and Sun Resorts lost 20 cents to 35.50 rupees on 22,484 shares.
These four stocks attracted 80 percent of the total volume while the rest of the market remained dull on concerns of the present uncertain political climate in the country, brokers said.
British American Insurance was down by 10 cents to 7.10 rupees on 6,000 shares. Mauritius Breweries fell by 2 rupees to 118 on 647 shares.
Mauritius Stationery Manufacturers was 70 cents lower to 48 rupees on 130 shares.
Fincorp Investment gained a rupee to 71 on 2,098 shares. National Investment Trust (NIT) shed 60 cents to 11.10 rupees on 6,700 shares. NIT was traded ex-dividend on Wendesday.
Sugar-based Mon Tresor Mon Desert was unchanged at 35 rupees on 13,710 shares while Savannah (ordinary) gained one rupee to 125 on 2,605 shares.
Conglomerates Rogers was stable at 89 rupees on 4,450 shares and Ireland Blyth lost 20 cents to 12.30 rupees on 350 shares.
Grand Baie Hotel fell by 50 cents to 33.20 rupees on 1,890 shares and national carrier Air Mauritius remained at 50 rupees on 200 shares.
